title: Standard Chartered Visa Infinite credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Visa Infinite premium card from SCB delivering luxury travel privileges, concierge support, milestone benefits, and higher earn rates for international travelers.
cardOverview.bestSuited: Travel Booking, Airline Transfer, Hotel Transfer

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Get a dedicated Global Concierge for 24x7 assistance towards health & wellness, dining, travel and cultural events.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Reach out to Aspire Lifestyle at 022 4232 0274 or 1800 102 7274 for assistance.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: Access to premier golf courses within India along with 2 complimentary golf lessons per month
benefitRows.howToAvail: Access the designated golf booking portal using the email ID registered with your credit card. Choose your preferred golf course, date, and time, and complete the booking. You’ll receive a confirmation via email, take this with you when you play. Note that additional costs like caddy fees and carts are usually not covered and must be paid at the course.
